purpose: Defines the UI/backend event payload for future streaming ASR and streaming translation updates.
non_goal: This contract does not claim local realtime streaming is already validated.

ui_expectation.partial_events: Render inline and replace the previous partial text for the same session.
ui_expectation.final_events: Commit final transcript/translation into the conversation card.
ui_expectation.error_events: Show a visible but non-blocking status message.

readiness_rule: Gemini-class readiness must not advance until this contract is backed by target-PC runtime evidence.
